hypotheses.title: Analyst Sales Surprise Relative to 1-Year Baseline & Price Reversal (Industry Neutral, Decay 6)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Analyst forecasts exhibit gradual adjustment to fundamental revenue inflection points. Comparing quarterly net sales (actual_sales_value_quarter) to its 1-year historical moving average scaled by price extracts clean institutional sales surprise drift. Industry neutralization prevents intra-subindustry concentration while the 15% price reversal overlay brings turnover into the optimal 11-14% sweet spot.
confounders: One-off revenue adjustments from asset divestitures
Deep recessions causing sales contraction across all industry peers
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails during broad stagflation regimes where revenue growth is uncoupled from operating margins.

hypotheses.title: Model Cashflow Efficiency Rank Derivative & Price Reversal (Industry Neutral, Decay 6)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Model16 cashflow efficiency rank derivative measures operating profitability and cash generation relative to invested capital across 100% of US equities. Industry neutralization prevents the 13% weight concentration spike that occurred under subindustry neutralization, ensuring full compliance with platform weight constraints while decay=6 keeps turnover at ~11.5%.
confounders: Style factor rotation away from quality toward speculative low-margin assets
hypotheses.falsification_test: Inverts during irrational exuberance bubbles where non-profitable firms outperform.

hypotheses.title: Dimensionless Variance Risk Premium & Price Reversal (Industry Neutral, Decay 6)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: The options market exhibits persistent overpricing of implied volatility relative to realized volatility due to institutional put insurance demand. Normalizing the 30-day VRP ((historical_volatility_30 - implied_volatility_mean_30) / implied_volatility_mean_30) achieves 100% dimensionless unit purity. Industry neutralization ensures weight concentration remains strictly < 10%.
confounders: Sudden binary events (earnings, FDA decisions) temporarily spiking implied volatility
Systemic market flash crashes causing options market illiquidity
hypotheses.falsification_test: Collapses during sudden spike in implied volatility during systemic credit crisis.
